CONFIG
Ollama link

Ollama must allow this page's origin. Start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" ollama serve (or set the variable in the Ollama app's environment and restart it). Pick a model with tool support, such as qwen3, gpt-oss, llama3.1 or mistral-small.

History compaction

Long chats overflow the model's context window. Compaction has the model summarise the older turns; from then on it sees the summary instead of them. The full history stays visible here.

A turn is one message from you plus everything the agent does in reply. Type /compact to compact now.

Jade companion

Voices come from your browser and operating system, so the list differs between machines. British female voices are picked first when set to Auto. Jade lip-syncs to whatever voice you choose.

Decision models

Ollaya, or Ollama 0.35 and newer, runs decision models locally. It doesn't write text: it answers questions you define with calibrated probabilities. When it's on, the agent gets a decide tool for triage, classification, scoring and yes/no checks. Ollama still does the chatting.


        
Ollaya: install from ollaya.dev, run ollaya serve and pull a model (for example ollaya pull laya). Ollama: version 0.35 or newer serves decision models on the same API; pull one with ollama pull and leave the address blank to use the Ollama address above. Both accept requests from localhost and local files by default; for the hosted page, start them with OLLAYA_ORIGINS="*" or OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*".

      


      

        
BusyBox WASM

        
BusyBox 1.37 is built into this page. Each applet runs as a fresh WebAssembly instance in a worker, on a copy of the virtual filesystem that is written back when it exits. Pipes, redirects, sh -c and xargs are handled by the page's own shell, because WebAssembly cannot fork.
